zh: 我好像把护照落在房间的保险箱里了。
target: I think I left ... / I might have left ...
refs: I think I left my passport in the safe in my room.
I might have left my passport in the room safe.

variants.zh: 我好像把手机落在刚才那辆出租车上了。
refs: I think I left my phone in the taxi I just took.
I might have left my phone in the taxi I was just in.

variants.zh: 我好像把房卡落在餐厅里了。
refs: I think I left my key card in the restaurant.
I might have left my room key in the restaurant.

notes: “落在某处”用 leave，不用 forget / lose；保险箱 = safe；“好像”要译出来；过去可能做了某事 = might have + 过去分词（不能说 might lost）；出租车 / 小汽车用 in，不用 on；take 过去式 took

zh: 这可能是因为反馈信号太弱，无法引导模型。
refs: This may be because the feedback signal is too weak to guide the model.
This is likely because the feedback signal is too weak to guide the model.

variants.zh: 这可能是因为测试用例太少，没能覆盖边界情况。
refs: This may be because there are too few test cases to cover the edge cases.
This may be because the test cases are too few to cover the edge cases.

variants.zh: 这可能是因为模型缺乏针对特定硬件的知识。
refs: This may be because the model lacks hardware-specific knowledge.
This is likely because the model lacks knowledge specific to particular hardware.

notes: 论文里用 may / is likely，避免 maybe；太……无法 = too ... to；“反馈信号”= feedback signal，不能只说 signal；might be because 不能漏 be；针对特定硬件的知识 = hardware-specific knowledge

zh: 我的航班很早就到了，请问能不能提前入住？
refs: My flight got in really early. Would it be possible to check in early?
My flight arrived very early, so would it be possible to get an early check-in?

variants.zh: 我的航班是晚上的，请问能不能晚点退房？
refs: My flight isn't until the evening. Would it be possible to check out late?
My flight's in the evening, so would it be possible to get a late checkout?

variants.zh: 房间外面有点吵，请问能不能换个房间？
refs: It's a bit noisy outside my room. Would it be possible to change rooms?
It's a little noisy outside my room. Would it be possible to move to a different room?

notes: 很早就到了 = got in / arrived (really) early，不是 arrived a long time ago；避免 Can you help me to ... / Is there any possibility to ...；换房间 = change rooms（复数），不说 change my room；晚上的航班 = isn't until tonight / this evening，不说 until night

zh: 能否请审稿人具体说明对实验设置的顾虑？
refs: Could the reviewer clarify their specific concerns about the experimental setup?
Could the reviewer elaborate on their specific concerns regarding the experimental setup?

variants.zh: 能否请审稿人指明是哪个实验结果不够清楚？
refs: Could the reviewer specify which experimental result is unclear?
Could the reviewer clarify which experimental result they found unclear?

variants.zh: 能否请审稿人提供与这一点相关的参考文献？
refs: Could the reviewer provide references related to this point?
Could the reviewer point us to relevant references on this point?

notes: rebuttal 中请求审稿人时用第三人称 the reviewer，不用 you / me；实验设置 = experimental setup；顾虑 = concerns；参考文献 = references（复数），不用 essays；references related to / on this point，不说 reference about

zh: 账单上这个价格好像跟网上写的不一样。
refs: The price on the bill doesn't seem to match the one listed online.
This price on the bill doesn't seem to match what it said online.

variants.zh: 这个房价好像比我预订时高了一点。
refs: This room rate seems a bit higher than when I booked.
The room rate seems slightly higher than the rate I booked at.

variants.zh: 找给我的零钱好像少了十块。
refs: My change seems to be ten short.
The change you gave me seems to be ten short.

notes: 避免 is wrong / is different，太直接；不一样 = doesn't match；different 后面接 from，不接 with；零钱 = change；少了十块 = ten short / short by ten；“高了一点”= a bit / slightly higher，不是 much；比预订时 = than when I booked，不是 than I booked

zh: 消融结果表明，反思模块对正确率很重要。
refs: The ablation results suggest that the reflection module is important for accuracy.
The ablation results suggest that the reflection module is important for correctness.

variants.zh: 实验结果表明，更多的迭代有助于进一步提速。
refs: The experimental results suggest that more iterations help achieve further speedups.
Our experimental results suggest that additional iterations help deliver further speedups.

variants.zh: 这些结果表明，硬件反馈比代码示例更有用。
refs: These results suggest that hardware feedback is more useful than code examples.
These results suggest that hardware feedback is more helpful than code examples.

notes: suggest that 比 show that 更谨慎；消融结果 = ablation results（experimental 是形容词，不能当名词）；module 不是 model；正确率 = accuracy / correctness；“更有用”不要加 much（加料）；代码示例 = code examples；有助于进一步提速 = help achieve further speedups（help 后接动词，不接 for 或名词）；iterations 复数，动词用 help / are，不用 helps / is；“有助于”不要直译成 is helpful for / to；论文里 suggest 后保留 that

zh: 我明天早上六点要去机场，能帮我叫辆出租车吗？
refs: I'm leaving for the airport at 6 tomorrow morning. Could you book me a taxi?
I'm heading to the airport at 6 a.m. tomorrow. Could you call me a taxi?

variants.zh: 我的箱子有点重，能帮我把行李送到房间吗？
refs: My suitcase is a bit heavy. Could you have my luggage brought up to my room?
My suitcase is a little heavy. Could you bring my luggage up to my room?

variants.zh: 我的手机没电了，能帮我打印一下登机牌吗？
refs: My phone's dead. Could you print my boarding pass for me?
My phone's out of battery. Could you print out my boarding pass?

notes: “帮我做某事”不必译成 help me，直接 Could you + 动词；六点“去”机场是出发时间，用 leaving for / heading to，不用 get to（= 到达）；登机牌 = boarding pass，不是 onboarding ticket；Could you 后接动词原形，不接 helping；箱子 = suitcase，backpack 是双肩包

zh: 你介意把复现实验的代码发给我看看吗？
refs: Would you mind sending me the code for reproducing the experiments so I can take a look?
Would you mind sending me your reproduction code so I can have a look?

variants.zh: 你介意帮我看一下这个 kernel 为什么这么慢吗？
refs: Would you mind taking a look at why this kernel is so slow?
Would you mind looking into why this kernel is so slow?

variants.zh: 你介意在投稿前帮我改一下摘要吗？
refs: Would you mind revising the abstract for me before we submit?
Would you mind polishing the abstract for me before submission?

notes: mind 后面接 -ing；复现 = reproduce / reproduction；“看看”= so I can take a look；摘要 = abstract，不是 abstraction；“帮我看一下 / 改一下”不说 helping me to + 动词，mind 后直接接对方要做的动作（taking a look at / revising），需要时句末加 for me；check why 不自然，用 take a look at why / look into why

zh: 天气不好，我的航班可能会延误一两个小时。
refs: The weather's bad, so my flight might be delayed an hour or two.
My flight might be delayed by an hour or two because of the bad weather.

variants.zh: 前一班晚点了，我们可能会错过转机。
refs: Our first flight is running late, so we might miss our connection.
Our previous flight was delayed, so we might miss our connecting flight.

variants.zh: 现在是旺季，市中心的酒店可能都订满了。
refs: It's peak season, so the hotels downtown might all be booked up.
Since it's peak season, the hotels in the city center might all be fully booked.

notes: 转机 = connecting flight / connection；订满 = fully booked / booked up；“都”要译出 all；航班延误用被动 be delayed，不说 my flight might delay（主动的 delay 主语是原因：The storm delayed my flight）；一两个小时 = an hour or two 比 one or two hours 地道

zh: 我们的方法可能也适用于 AMD 以外的其他硬件。
target: may also apply to / generalize to
refs: Our approach may also apply to hardware beyond AMD.
Our method may also generalize to non-AMD hardware.

variants.zh: 这个结论可能也适用于用 CUDA 编写的 kernel。
refs: This conclusion may also apply to kernels written in CUDA.
This conclusion may also hold for kernels written in CUDA.

variants.zh: 该框架可能也适用于其他 GPU 编程语言。
refs: This framework may also apply to other GPU programming languages.
This framework may also extend to other GPU programming languages.

notes: 适用于 = apply to / hold for / extend to / generalize to / be applicable to，不说 suit for（suit 直接接宾语，意思是“合适”），也不说 be useful for（= 有用，不是适用）；be applicable 后接 to，不接 for；以外 = beyond / non-AMD，“以外的其他”译一个就行，不必再加 other；hardware 不可数，不加 s；“也”要译出 also

zh: 我已经退房了，能把行李在这儿寄存到下午吗？
refs: I've already checked out. Could I leave my luggage here until this afternoon?
I've checked out already. Could I leave my bags here until the afternoon?

variants.zh: 我忘带充电器了，能跟你们借一个吗？
refs: I forgot to bring my charger. Could I borrow one from you?
I forgot my charger. Could I borrow one from you?

variants.zh: 订房之前，我能先看一下房间吗？
refs: Before I book, could I take a look at the room first?
Could I see the room first before I book?

notes: 寄存行李 = leave my luggage 最自然，store my luggage 也可以，不用 deposit；行李 = luggage / bags，package 是包裹；put 只是“放下”，不能接 until 表示寄存；“到下午”= until this afternoon / the afternoon，不说 until afternoon；May I 也可以，比 Could I 稍正式；已经退房用现在完成时

zh: 实验还没跑完，能不能把截止日期推后几天？
refs: The experiments haven't finished running yet. Would it be possible to extend the deadline by a few days?
Our experiments are still running. Would it be possible to push the deadline back a few days?

variants.zh: 我周四要出差，能不能把组会改到周五？
refs: I'm away on a business trip on Thursday. Would it be possible to move the group meeting to Friday?
I'll be on a business trip on Thursday, so would it be possible to reschedule the group meeting to Friday?

variants.zh: 我们的显卡不够用，能不能借用一下你们的集群？
refs: We don't have enough GPUs. Would it be possible to borrow your cluster for a while?
We're short on GPUs. Would it be possible to use your cluster for a bit?

notes: 推迟截止日期 = extend / push back the deadline；还没跑完用现在完成时或进行时；出差 = business trip

zh: 要是早知道会堵车，我们就坐地铁去机场了。
target: If I'd / we'd known ..., ... would have + 过去分词
refs: If we'd known there would be traffic, we would have taken the subway to the airport.
If we had known about the traffic jam, we would have taken the metro to the airport.

variants.zh: 要是早知道要排这么久的队，我就提前在网上值机了。
refs: If I'd known the line would be this long, I would have checked in online in advance.
If I had known I'd have to wait in line this long, I would have checked in online ahead of time.

variants.zh: 要是早知道酒店离市区这么远，我们就不订这家了。
refs: If we'd known the hotel was this far from downtown, we wouldn't have booked it.
If we had known the hotel was so far from the city center, we wouldn't have booked this one.

notes: 对过去的假设：If + had + 过去分词, ... would have + 过去分词；主句不能用 will 或 would + 动词原形（不说 we will take / we would take）；早知道 = If I'd known（I'd = I had）；堵车 = traffic / a traffic jam；值机 = check in；提前 = in advance / ahead of time，不要漏译；这么远 = this far / so far；不订这家 = wouldn't have booked it

zh: 与基线方法相比，GEAK 往往能生成更快的 kernel。
refs: Compared with the baselines, GEAK tends to generate faster kernels.
GEAK tends to produce faster kernels than the baseline methods.

variants.zh: 在大规模输入上，更多的迭代往往带来更大的提速。
refs: On large inputs, more iterations tend to yield larger speedups.
For large-scale inputs, additional iterations tend to bring greater speedups.

variants.zh: 访存模式规则的算子往往更容易优化。
refs: Operators with regular memory access patterns tend to be easier to optimize.
Operators whose memory access patterns are regular tend to be easier to optimize.

notes: “往往”= tend to / often，不要漏译；基线 = baselines；访存模式 = memory access patterns

zh: 这间房比刚才那间安静多了，就要这间吧。
target: much / a lot + 比较级 + than
refs: This room is much quieter than the one we just saw. I'll take this one.
This room is a lot quieter than the last one. Let's go with this one.

variants.zh: 坐火车比坐大巴快多了，而且也贵不了多少。
refs: Taking the train is much faster than taking the bus, and it's not much more expensive either.
The train is a lot faster than the bus, and it isn't much more expensive either.

variants.zh: 网上订票比在柜台买便宜多了，能省将近一半。
refs: Booking tickets online is much cheaper than buying them at the counter. You can save nearly half.
Buying tickets online is a lot cheaper than buying them at the counter. You save almost half.

notes: “……多了”= much / a lot / far + 比较级，不说 very quieter / more quieter；quiet 要变成 quieter；刚才那间 = the one we just saw / the last one；就要这间 = I'll take this one；贵不了多少 = not much more expensive，否定句里的“也”= either；将近一半 = nearly / almost half，不要漏译“将近”

zh: 如果没有 Reflector，智能体很可能会陷入调试死循环。
refs: Without the Reflector, the agent would likely get stuck in a debugging trap.
Without the Reflector, the agent would most likely get stuck in an endless debugging loop.

variants.zh: 如果没有硬件反馈，生成的 kernel 很可能会慢得多。
refs: Without hardware feedback, the generated kernels would likely be much slower.
Without hardware feedback, the generated kernels would most likely be far slower.

variants.zh: 如果没有这些单元测试，很多错误的 kernel 会被当成正确的。
refs: Without these unit tests, many incorrect kernels would be treated as correct.
Without these unit tests, many faulty kernels would be counted as correct.

notes: “如果没有 X”的假设：Without X, ... would + 动词原形，不用 will；也可以说 If it weren't for X；很可能 = likely / most likely，放在 would 后面（would likely get）；陷入调试死循环 = get stuck in a debugging trap；慢得多 = much / far slower；被当成正确的 = be treated / counted as correct；错误的 kernel = incorrect kernels

zh: 我等了半个多小时，行李好像还没出来。
target: doesn't seem to have + 过去分词 / It looks like ...
refs: I've been waiting for over half an hour, and my luggage doesn't seem to have come out yet.
I've been waiting for more than half an hour, and it looks like my bags still haven't come out.

variants.zh: 已经过去一周了，我的退款好像还没到账。
refs: It's been a week, and my refund doesn't seem to have come through yet.
It's been a week already, and it looks like my refund still hasn't come through.

variants.zh: 我昨天就付了钱，但预订好像还没确认。
refs: I paid yesterday, but my booking doesn't seem to have been confirmed yet.
I already paid yesterday, but it looks like my reservation still hasn't been confirmed.

notes: “还没”要用完成体；等了多久用 have been waiting；半个多小时 = over half an hour；到账 = come through

zh: 在 TritonBench 上，我们的方法比最强的基线快了 15%。
target: outperform X by 15% / 15% faster than X
refs: On TritonBench, our method outperforms the strongest baseline by 15%.
On TritonBench, our method is 15% faster than the strongest baseline.

variants.zh: 加入 Optimizer 后，正确率比原来提高了 12 个百分点。
refs: Adding the Optimizer improves accuracy by 12 percentage points over the original version.
With the Optimizer added, accuracy is 12 percentage points higher than before.

variants.zh: 在 MI300X 上，我们生成的 kernel 平均比参考实现快了 20%。
refs: On the MI300X, our generated kernels are 20% faster than the reference implementations on average.
On MI300X, our generated kernels outperform the reference implementations by 20% on average.

notes: 带百分比的比较：outperform X by 15% 或 15% faster than X，by 不能省（不说 outperform X 15%），也不说 faster 15% than；百分点 = percentage points（50% 提到 62% 是提高了 12 个百分点，不是 12%）；最强的基线 = the strongest baseline；比原来 = than before / over the original；参考实现 = reference implementation；平均 = on average，不要漏译

zh: 机票订得越早，价格一般就越便宜，尤其是在旺季的时候。
target: The + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...
refs: The earlier you book your flight, the cheaper it usually is, especially during peak season.
The earlier you book, the cheaper the tickets generally are, especially in peak season.

variants.zh: 酒店离市中心越远就越便宜，不过每天打车的费用也会越高。
refs: The farther the hotel is from downtown, the cheaper it is, but the more you'll spend on taxis every day.
The farther a hotel is from the city center, the cheaper it gets, but the higher your daily taxi costs will be.

variants.zh: 越临近出发，改签的手续费就越高，所以最好早点决定。
refs: The closer it gets to departure, the higher the change fee, so it's best to decide early.
The closer you get to your departure date, the higher the rebooking fee, so you'd better decide soon.

notes: 越……越…… = the + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...，两半都要有 the + 比较级，不说 more early more cheap / the more early；后半句可以省略 be 动词（the higher the change fee）；一般 = usually / generally，尤其是 = especially，都不要漏译；离……越远 = the farther ... from；每天 = every day / daily；改签手续费 = change fee / rebooking fee；最好 = it's best to / you'd better

zh: 审稿人要求补充结果，你能在 H100 上再跑一遍吗？
refs: The reviewer asked for additional results. Could you rerun the experiments on an H100?
The reviewer has requested additional results. Could you run the experiments again on the H100?

variants.zh: 为了方便对比，你能把结果整理成一张表吗？
refs: To make comparison easier, could you organize the results into a single table?
Could you put the results into one table so they're easier to compare?

variants.zh: 为了回应审稿人，你能补一组消融实验吗？
refs: To address the reviewer's comment, could you add an ablation study?
To respond to the reviewer, could you run an additional ablation study?

notes: 补充结果 = additional results；再跑一遍 = rerun；消融实验 = ablation study；回应审稿人 = address the reviewer's comment

zh: 航班被取消了，要是买了旅行保险就好了。
target: I wish I had + 过去分词
refs: My flight got canceled. I wish I'd bought travel insurance.
My flight's been canceled. I wish I had gotten travel insurance.

variants.zh: 外面突然下起了大雨，要是出门时带了伞就好了。
refs: It suddenly started pouring outside. I wish I'd brought an umbrella when I went out.
All of a sudden it's pouring outside. I wish I had taken an umbrella with me when I left.

variants.zh: 这家餐厅要排两个小时，要是提前订位就好了。
refs: There's a two-hour wait at this restaurant. I wish we'd booked a table in advance.
The wait at this restaurant is two hours. I wish we had made a reservation ahead of time.

notes: 对过去的遗憾：I wish I had + 过去分词（I wish I'd bought），不说 I wish I bought / I wish I could buy；If only I had ... 意思一样；“就好了”不要直译成 it would be good；旅行保险 = travel insurance；突然 = suddenly / all of a sudden，不要漏译；订位 = book a table / make a reservation；提前 = in advance；排两个小时 = a two-hour wait

zh: 要是用了更大的测试集，我们应该能更早发现这个 bug。
target: If we had + 过去分词, ... would / might have + 过去分词
refs: If we had used a larger test suite, we would probably have caught this bug earlier.
If we'd used a bigger test set, we probably could have found this bug sooner.

variants.zh: 如果当时在 MI300X 上做实验，提速可能会更明显。
refs: If we had run the experiments on the MI300X, the speedup might have been more pronounced.
If we had conducted the experiments on the MI300X, the speedup might have been more noticeable.

variants.zh: 要是当初早点开源代码，论文的引用可能会更多。
refs: If we had open-sourced the code earlier, the paper might have gotten more citations.
If we'd released the code sooner, the paper might have been cited more.

notes: 对过去实验的假设：If we had + 过去分词, ... would / might have + 过去分词，主句不用 will 或 would + 动词原形；应该能 = would probably have / probably could have；可能会 = might have；“更早”“早点”= earlier / sooner，不要漏译；测试集 = test suite / test set；更明显 = more pronounced / noticeable；开源 = open-source / release the code；论文里也可以倒装：Had we used ...

zh: 您介意帮我们拍张照吗？把后面的塔也拍进去。
refs: Would you mind taking a photo of us? Could you get the tower behind us in the shot too?
Would you mind taking a picture of us, with the tower behind us in the background?

variants.zh: 我想和朋友坐在一起，您介意和我换个座位吗？
refs: I'd like to sit with my friend. Would you mind switching seats with me?
I'd like to sit next to my friend. Would you mind swapping seats with me?

variants.zh: 我们明天要早起，您介意把音乐关小一点吗？
refs: We have to get up early tomorrow. Would you mind turning the music down a bit?
We've got an early start tomorrow. Would you mind turning the music down a little?

notes: mind 后面接 -ing，不接 to do；“帮我们拍照”不用 help us；后面的塔 = the tower behind us

zh: 智能体一周探索的优化方向，远远多于工程师几个月能尝试的。
refs: In one week, the agent explores far more optimization directions than an engineer could try in several months.
The number of optimization directions the agent explores in a week far exceeds what an engineer could try in several months.

variants.zh: 即使算上编译和测试，智能体的总开销也远低于人工调优的成本。
refs: Even including compilation and testing, the agent's total cost is far lower than that of manual tuning.
Even with compilation and testing included, the agent's overall cost is still far below the cost of manual tuning.

variants.zh: 在小矩阵上，GEAK 的优势通常远没有在大矩阵上那么明显。
refs: On small matrices, GEAK's advantage is typically far less pronounced than on large ones.
GEAK's advantage on small matrices is usually far smaller than on large matrices.

notes: “远远……”= far + 比较级（far more / far less / far lower），或 far exceed / far below；不说 very more / much much more；比较对象要同类：far lower than that of manual tuning；远没有……那么明显 = far less pronounced than；人工调优 = manual tuning / hand-tuning；即使算上 = even including；通常 = typically / usually，不要漏译；几个月 = several months

zh: 路上有点堵，我们可能要晚一个小时才能到酒店。
refs: Traffic's a bit heavy, so we'll probably get to the hotel an hour late.
There's a bit of traffic, so we'll probably be an hour late getting to the hotel.

variants.zh: 明天的航班很晚，我们可能需要晚一点退房。
refs: Our flight tomorrow is pretty late, so we'll probably need to check out a bit later.
Our flight tomorrow is really late, so we'll probably need a late checkout.

variants.zh: 签证还没下来，我可能得把航班改到下周。
refs: My visa hasn't come through yet, so I'll probably have to move my flight to next week.
My visa still isn't ready, so I'll probably need to change my flight to next week.

notes: 到酒店用 get to / arrive at，不用 arrive to；有点堵 = traffic's a bit heavy

zh: 根据 profiling 结果，提速似乎主要来自内存优化。
refs: Based on the profiling results, the speedup appears to come mainly from memory optimizations.
According to the profiling results, the speedup appears to stem primarily from memory optimizations.

variants.zh: 从日志来看，大部分错误似乎出在编译阶段。
refs: Judging from the logs, most errors appear to occur during the compilation stage.
Based on the logs, most of the errors appear to stem from the compilation stage.

variants.zh: 与卷积相比，模型似乎更擅长优化矩阵乘法。
refs: Compared with convolution, the model appears to be better at optimizing matrix multiplication.
The model appears to be better at optimizing matrix multiplication than convolution.

notes: 似乎 = appears to / seems to；来自 = come from / stem from；“主要”= mainly / primarily，不要漏译

zh: 市中心的酒店差不多是郊区的两倍价钱。
target: twice / three times / half as ... as
refs: Hotels downtown are almost twice as expensive as the ones in the suburbs.
Hotels in the city center cost about twice as much as those in the suburbs.

variants.zh: 这趟直飞的时间，只有转机航班的一半。
refs: This direct flight takes only half as long as the connecting one.
The direct flight takes just half as long as the one with a layover.

variants.zh: 旺季的机票价格，差不多是平时的三倍。
refs: In peak season, plane tickets cost almost three times as much as usual.
During peak season, airfares are about three times as expensive as they normally are.

notes: 倍数比较：twice / three times / half + as + 形容词（或 much）+ as，不说 two times expensive than；three times more expensive than 口语里也常听到，但 as ... as 最稳妥；差不多 = almost / about，不要漏译；“只有”= only / just；直飞 = direct flight / nonstop；转机 = connecting flight / with a layover；旺季 = peak season；平时 = usual / normally

zh: 和 PyTorch 原生实现相比，这个 kernel 带来了 2.3 倍的提速。
target: a 2.3× speedup over X / 2.3 times faster than X
refs: This kernel achieves a 2.3× speedup over the native PyTorch implementation.
Compared with the native PyTorch implementation, this kernel is 2.3 times faster.

variants.zh: 在 MI250 上，提速幅度只有 MI300X 上的一半左右。
refs: On the MI250, the speedup is only about half of that on the MI300X.
The speedup on the MI250 is only about half as large as on the MI300X.

variants.zh: 迭代二十轮之后，正确率是第一轮的三倍多。
refs: After 20 iterations, the accuracy is more than three times that of the first iteration.
After twenty iterations, accuracy is over three times as high as in the first round.

notes: 倍数提速 = a 2.3× speedup over X 或 2.3 times faster than X（2.3× 读作 two point three times / x）；比较对象要同类：half of that on the MI300X、three times that of the first iteration（that 指前面的 speedup / accuracy），不说 half of the MI300X；只有 = only，左右 = about / roughly，都不要漏译；三倍多 = more than / over three times；原生实现 = native implementation

zh: 要不是航班延误了三个小时，我们现在早就到酒店了。
target: If ... hadn't + 过去分词, ... would + 动词原形 (by now)
refs: If our flight hadn't been delayed by three hours, we'd be at the hotel by now.
If it hadn't been for the three-hour flight delay, we'd already be at the hotel.

variants.zh: 要不是你提醒我带转换插头，我的手机现在早就没电了。
refs: If you hadn't reminded me to bring a plug adapter, my phone would be dead by now.
If you hadn't reminded me to pack an adapter, my phone would already be dead.

variants.zh: 要不是在机场换了一部分钱，我们现在连打车的现金都没有。
refs: If we hadn't exchanged some money at the airport, we wouldn't even have cash for a taxi now.
If we hadn't changed some money at the airport, we wouldn't even have enough cash for a taxi right now.

notes: 过去的事影响现在（混合虚拟）：If + had + 过去分词, ... would + 动词原形，例如 If our flight hadn't been delayed, we'd be at the hotel by now；主句也可以说 we would have arrived by now；要不是 = If ... hadn't ... / If it hadn't been for ...；航班延误用被动 hadn't been delayed；早就……了 = already / by now；转换插头 = plug adapter；连……都没有 = not even；一部分钱 = some money；换钱 = exchange / change money

zh: 我想问一下，我们能否在论文中使用你们的 benchmark。
refs: I was wondering if we could use your benchmark in our paper.
I was wondering whether we might use your benchmark in our paper.

variants.zh: 我想问一下，能否在论文中引用你们未发表的结果。
refs: I was wondering if we could cite your unpublished results in our paper.
I was wondering whether we might cite your unpublished results in our paper.

variants.zh: 我想问一下，你们是否打算在论文发表后开源代码。
refs: I was wondering if you plan to open-source the code after the paper is published.
I was wondering whether you're planning to release the code once the paper is published.

notes: was wondering 后面的从句用陈述语序，不倒装；开源 = open-source / release the code

zh: 我想问一下能不能换个靠窗的座位，最好靠前一点。
target: I was wondering if I could ...
refs: I was wondering if I could switch to a window seat, preferably near the front.
I was wondering if I could change to a window seat, ideally a bit closer to the front.

variants.zh: 我想问一下能不能升舱，大概要补多少钱。
refs: I was wondering if I could get an upgrade, and roughly how much extra it would cost.
I was wondering if I could upgrade, and about how much more I'd need to pay.

variants.zh: 我想问一下房费里是不是包含两个人的早餐。
refs: I was wondering if the room rate includes breakfast for two.
I was wondering whether breakfast for two is included in the room rate.

notes: 升舱 = upgrade，不是 promotion；最好 = preferably / ideally；换座位用 switch / change to

zh: 如果能和 FlashAttention-4 对比一下，结果会更有说服力。
target: ... would be more ... if we + 过去式
refs: The results would be more convincing if we compared them with FlashAttention-4.
Our results would be more convincing if we included a comparison with FlashAttention-4.

variants.zh: 如果能多跑几组随机种子，结论会更可靠。
refs: The conclusions would be more reliable if we ran a few more random seeds.
Our conclusions would be more robust if we ran experiments with a few more random seeds.

variants.zh: 如果把消融实验放进正文，审稿人会更容易看懂。
refs: The reviewers would find it easier to follow if we moved the ablation study into the main text.
It would be easier for the reviewers to understand if we put the ablation study in the main paper.

notes: 对现在或将来的假设、委婉建议：... would + 动词原形 + if we + 过去式（compared / ran / moved），不说 will be ... if we compare；有说服力 = convincing；可靠 = reliable / robust；多跑几组 = run a few more；随机种子 = random seeds；正文 = main text / main paper（附录 = appendix）；看懂 = follow / understand

zh: 要是我是你，我就先去柜台问问能不能改签。
refs: If I were you, I'd go to the counter first and ask if you can rebook.
If I were you, I'd check at the counter first to see whether you can change your flight.

variants.zh: 要是我是你，我会早点去机场，安检要排很久的队。
refs: If I were you, I'd get to the airport early. You have to wait a long time at security.
If I were you, I'd head to the airport a bit earlier. The security line takes a long time.

variants.zh: 要是我是你，我就不在机场换钱，汇率太差了。
refs: If I were you, I wouldn't exchange money at the airport. The rate is terrible.
If I were you, I wouldn't change money at the airport. The exchange rate is awful.

notes: 给建议：If I were you, I'd + 动词原形（I'd = I would），从句用 were（口语里也有人说 was，但 were 更标准），主句不用 will；否定是 I wouldn't；改签 = rebook / change your flight；柜台 = counter / desk；“先”= first，不要漏译；早点 = early / a bit earlier；安检 = security；换钱 = exchange / change money；汇率 = exchange rate

zh: 加入反思模块后，正确率明显提高，延迟只增加了一点。
target: significantly / slightly + 比较级或动词
refs: Adding the reflection module significantly improves accuracy, while latency increases only slightly.
With the reflection module, accuracy is substantially higher, while latency is only slightly higher.

variants.zh: 两种提示方式的结果差别很小，基本在测量误差以内。
refs: The two prompting strategies differ only slightly in their results, mostly within measurement noise.
The results of the two prompting methods differ only marginally, largely within measurement noise.

variants.zh: 和单次生成相比，多轮迭代的代码质量明显更好。
refs: Compared with single-pass generation, multi-round iteration produces significantly better code.
Multi-round iteration yields code of substantially higher quality than single-pass generation.

notes: 程度副词放在比较级或动词前：significantly / substantially（明显）、slightly / marginally（略微、一点）；论文里不说 very much better / a little bit；significantly 在严格的论文里暗示做过显著性检验，也可以用 substantially / notably；明显 ≠ obviously；“只”= only，不要漏译；反思模块 = reflection module；在测量误差以内 = within measurement noise；基本 = mostly / largely；单次生成 = single-pass / one-shot generation

zh: 这家酒店离车站没有网上说的那么近。
refs: This hotel isn't as close to the station as it said online.
The hotel isn't as close to the station as the listing said.

variants.zh: 这里的早餐没有我们上一家酒店的好。
refs: The breakfast here isn't as good as at our last hotel.
Breakfast here isn't as good as the one at the last hotel we stayed at.

variants.zh: 这个景点没有照片上看起来那么大。
refs: This attraction isn't as big as it looks in the photos.
This place isn't as big as it looked in the pictures.

notes: “没有……那么……”= not as + 形容词原级 + as，不用比较级（不说 not closer than / less close）；网上说的 = it said online / the listing said；上一家酒店 = our last hotel / the last hotel we stayed at；景点 = attraction / sight；照片上看起来 = it looks in the photos

zh: 即使给智能体更多的时间，它可能也很难超过手写的 kernel。
target: Even if + 过去式, ... might / would still ...
refs: Even if the agent were given more time, it might still struggle to outperform hand-written kernels.
Even if the agent had more time, it might still find it hard to beat hand-written kernels.

variants.zh: 即使测试用例再多一倍，一些隐蔽的竞态条件可能还是发现不了。
refs: Even if we had twice as many test cases, some subtle race conditions might still go undetected.
Even if the number of test cases were doubled, some hidden race conditions might still not be caught.

variants.zh: 就算换成更大的模型，如果没有硬件反馈，提速可能也很有限。
refs: Even if we switched to a larger model, the speedup might still be limited without hardware feedback.
Even if we used a bigger model, the speedup would probably still be quite limited without hardware feedback.

notes: 假设性的让步：Even if + 过去式（were given / had / switched）, ... might / would still ...；“也”“还是”要译出 still；很难 = struggle to / find it hard to；超过 = outperform / beat；手写的 = hand-written；再多一倍 = twice as many / doubled；隐蔽的 = subtle / hidden；竞态条件 = race conditions；发现不了 = go undetected；很有限 = (quite) limited

zh: 你们要是早点通知我，我就能改签别的航班了。
target: could have + 过去分词（本来能……）
refs: If you had let me know earlier, I could have rebooked onto another flight.
If you'd told me sooner, I could have switched to a different flight.

variants.zh: 前台忘了叫醒我，不然我就能赶上机场大巴了。
refs: The front desk forgot my wake-up call. Otherwise, I could have caught the airport shuttle.
The front desk forgot to wake me up, or I could have made the airport bus.

variants.zh: 你们要是提前说要收押金，我本可以多带点现金。
refs: If you had mentioned the deposit in advance, I could have brought more cash.
If you'd told me beforehand that you take a deposit, I could have brought some extra cash.

notes: 过去本来能做到、实际没做到：could have + 过去分词（I could have rebooked），不说 I can / could rebook；条件从句用 If you had + 过去分词；早点 = earlier / sooner，提前 = in advance，都不要漏译；改签别的航班 = rebook onto / switch to another flight；不然 = otherwise / or；叫醒服务 = wake-up call；赶上 = catch / make；押金 = deposit

zh: 我们本应该在投稿前再检查一遍数值误差。
refs: We should have double-checked the numerical errors before submitting.
We should have checked for numerical errors again before submission.

variants.zh: 现在看来，我们当初应该用更多的 benchmark 来评估。
refs: In hindsight, we should have evaluated on more benchmarks.
Looking back, we should have used more benchmarks for evaluation.

variants.zh: 这个 bug 本来可以避免，我们早该加上边界检查。
refs: This bug could have been avoided. We should have added bounds checks earlier.
This bug could have been avoided. We should have added boundary checks long ago.

notes: 对过去该做而没做的事：should have + 过去分词（We should have checked），不说 should check / should checked；本来可以 = could have + 过去分词（could have been avoided）；现在看来 = in hindsight / looking back；再检查一遍 = double-check / check again；投稿前 = before submitting / before submission，不要漏译；数值误差 = numerical errors；边界检查 = bounds checks / boundary checks；早该 = should have ... earlier / long ago

zh: 这个套餐比单买便宜了将近三十欧，但不包括机场接送。
refs: This package is nearly 30 euros cheaper than booking everything separately, but it doesn't include airport transfers.
The package works out almost 30 euros cheaper than buying each part separately, but airport transfers aren't included.

variants.zh: 今晚的航班比明早的贵五十美元，但能省下一晚的酒店钱。
refs: Tonight's flight is 50 dollars more expensive than tomorrow morning's, but it saves us a night at a hotel.
The flight tonight costs 50 dollars more than the one tomorrow morning, but we'd save a night's hotel bill.

variants.zh: 坐这班大巴比打车慢了将近四十分钟，不过能省一大半的钱。
refs: Taking this bus is nearly 40 minutes slower than taking a taxi, but it saves you more than half the cost.
This bus takes almost 40 minutes longer than a taxi, but it costs less than half as much.

notes: 带具体差值的比较：数量 + 比较级 + than（30 euros cheaper than / 40 minutes slower than），也可以说 cheaper by 30 euros；不说 cheaper 30 euros than；将近 = nearly / almost，不要漏译；套餐 = package；单买 = buying separately；机场接送 = airport transfers；一大半 = more than half

zh: 问题规模越大，智能体生成的 kernel 相对基线的优势就越明显。
target: The + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...
refs: The larger the problem size, the more pronounced the advantage of the agent-generated kernels over the baseline.
The larger the problem size, the more clearly the agent-generated kernels outperform the baseline.

variants.zh: 迭代的轮数越多，提速就越大，但大约二十轮以后收益开始递减。
refs: The more iterations we run, the larger the speedup, but returns start to diminish after about 20 rounds.
The more iterations, the greater the speedup, although returns begin to diminish after roughly 20 iterations.

variants.zh: 测试用例覆盖得越全面，被误判为正确的 kernel 就会越少。
refs: The more comprehensive the test coverage, the fewer kernels are wrongly judged as correct.
The more complete the test coverage, the fewer kernels get mistakenly marked as correct.

notes: 越……越…… = the + 比较级 ..., the + 比较级 ...，两半都要有 the，不说 more large more obvious；可数名词用 fewer（fewer kernels），不可数用 less；问题规模 = problem size；相对基线的优势 = the advantage over the baseline；明显 = pronounced / clearly；收益递减 = diminishing returns；大约 = about / roughly，不要漏译；误判为正确 = wrongly judged / marked as correct
